post.description:
Restart ytpt (checks, downloads and this API) so a freshly installed yt-dlp is
picked up. The response comes first; the API is unreachable for a few seconds after.
Refused (409) while a download is running unless {"force": true}; an interrupted
download simply resumes after the restart.

Upgrade yt-dlp now. Takes effect after ytpt restarts. Refused while a
download is running (pip must not swap files under it).

post.description:
Creates the source and returns immediately; the first check runs in the
background (watch the events stream for its result).

Removes the source only; videos and files are kept and
show up under Orphaned if no other source tracks them.

changes_only hides no-op checks from the page (the cursor still advances
past them, so a page may hold fewer than `limit` items).

Comments saved with the video (download.download_comments, or fetched on
demand). Top-level comments are paged; replies come nested under their parent.

post.description:
Download just this video's comments now and save them next to the video,
whatever download.download_comments is set to. Can take a while.
Re-queue a downloaded video whose file went missing, at the top of the queue.

Search the data folders for a missing file (matched by the [id] in its
name) and re-attach it if found.
Re-queue a permanently failed video with a fresh retry budget.

Move a queued (or permanently failed) video to the top of the queue and
skip the cooldown gap so the worker picks it up right away. An in-flight
download isn't interrupted; this one starts as soon as it finishes.

With `{"account": "<id>"}` this single download uses that account's cookies
instead of the primary's (e.g. a members-only video only a side account can
see). It applies to this attempt only.

get.description:
Every video format YouTube currently offers for this video (best first).
Asks YouTube, so it takes a few seconds.
The video's quality upgrade, or null when none was requested.

schema.title: Response Get Upgrade Api Videos  Youtube Id  Upgrade Get

post.description:
Queue a re-download in another quality. It is staged next to the original, which
is not touched until you accept the result.

delete.description:
Cancel or discard the upgrade (any state): a running download is stopped and the
staged files are deleted. The original file is never touched.

post.description:
Replace the current file with the upgraded one. The old file and its sidecars
are deleted for good.
Reorder the download queue: put a queued video at a 1-based position.

Give up on a video now instead of waiting out its retries. A queued video
is marked failed immediately. A downloading one is aborted at the next
progress tick (or when its current attempt ends) and then marked failed with
no further retries; the response still says 'downloading' until then.
Failed videos can be retried afterwards.

SourceCreate.title: SourceCreate
SourceCreate.description:
Everything except `url` is optional and null by default: null means
'use the global setting' (scheduler.playlist_check_interval_seconds,
paths.data_dir) and the source type is auto-detected from the URL.

SourceUpdate.title: SourceUpdate
SourceUpdate.description:
Partial update: only fields present in the request body are applied, so
an explicit null clears check_interval_seconds/data_dir (global fallback).
